sentence: This project studies hardware-oriented attacks on deep neural network systems and builds defensive strategies against them.
This project develops risk modeling techniques and studies how cyber and terrorism insurance can handle catastrophic events.
This project builds technologies that speed up liquid chromatography by improving how the mobile phase is delivered and how separated compounds are detected.
This project builds a quantum computing system from neutral atom logical qubits and a digital twin that models system performance.
This project builds a low-cost toolkit for hands-on education in securing manufacturing systems that use artificial intelligence.
This project explores artificial intelligence, with a focus on deep learning and its ethical implications.
This project studies how deep eutectic solvents give off light in water by looking at how their molecules interact.
This project builds lessons about artificial intelligence that use educational robotics in linguistically diverse elementary classrooms.
This project builds perception systems that understand the 3D world and what actions can be done in it.
This project creates knot invariants by building cellular spaces from the chain complexes of existing knot invariants.
This project develops accelerated real-time analytics that use AI and programmable hardware, including for medical images.
This project builds a theory of topological invariants to explain how biological systems keep working despite noise and disorder.
This project studies moduli spaces using topology and geometric group theory and tries to establish their asphericality.
This project tests whether evolution is more predictable for traits built by simple genetic networks, using stickleback fish reintroduced into lakes.
This project studies why many organizations have not adopted a security mechanism that protects Internet routing and what could help them.
This project studies how subsurface structure controls where precipitation goes, including groundwater recharge, streamflow and plant water use.
This project studies how social and hydrological dynamics shape post-hurricane recovery of freshwater resources on small islands.
This project develops software to automate deposition of three-dimensional structures of large biological molecules into open-access data resources.
This project builds a sensor that detects nitrate, nitrite and ammonia in water in real time using polymers and bacteria.
This project studies security vulnerabilities in biometric systems and develops ways to protect their template data.
